rituals.ritualText:
PLAY TIME
70 sec

GAME
URGE IS NOT A SIGNATURE

GOAL
The feeling can stay.

ONE RULE
Guess the action your emotion is pushing you toward right now.

PLAY
Name the urge in one verb: send, shout, hide, quit, check, buy, apologise, chase. Say, “Feeling ___; action undecided.” Wait 10 sec.

TWIST
Check if the emotion remains present even when the action is not automatically executed.

MIND BEND
A feeling can vote without signing the behaviour contract.

SAFETY
PAUSE
Use the delay only for a harmless impulse. Basic needs, prescribed care and genuine safety actions come first; do not test this on an urge that could put you or someone else at risk.
